argv:
out=$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/729a-load-timeouts.XXXXXXXX")
printf 'Plant results: %s\n' "$out"
source="$out/source"
mkdir -p "$source"
inputs=$(jq -er '.inputs[]' "$1")
while IFS= read -r path; do
  mkdir -p "$source/$(dirname "$path")"
  cp -p -- "$path" "$source/$path"
done <<< "$inputs"
jq --argjson start "$2" --argjson end "$3" '
  .variants |= .[$start:$end] | if $start == 0 then .controls = [] else . end
' "$1" > "$source/partition.json"
uv run --script plugins/plant-defects/scripts/checked-plant run "$source/partition.json" "$out/results"
